content: An atomic manifest swap is useful for a local inference service because it allows for seamless and atomic updates to the model or service configuration without interrupting ongoing requests. This ensures high availability and reliability by preventing partial or inconsistent states during deployment, enabling the service to switch to a new version only when it is fully validated and ready, thus minimizing downtime and potential errors.
